body.objective: Determine whether the certified Weyl-anomaly matter lattice is compatible with exact four-dimensional gauge-anomaly cancellation for any bounded family of healthy chiral matter representations, and identify the first representation-theoretic obstruction or surviving solution families.
body.stop_condition: When pulled, import the terminal quantum-matter-content-anomaly-cancellation-lattice coefficients, conventions and exact solution or separating witnesses by hashes. Declare a finite but structurally complete search family of compact gauge groups and irreducible representations, beginning with U(1), SU(N), SO(N) and Sp(N) under explicit rank and highest-weight bounds and treating Standard-Model-like product factors separately. Compute exact cubic gauge, mixed gauge-gravitational, global mod-two where applicable, type-A/type-B Weyl-anomaly and one-loop gauge beta-function contributions for each representation using independent character/index and direct tensor-invariant rails. Solve the nonnegative integer multiplicity problem for simultaneous local gauge-anomaly cancellation and the declared Weyl-anomaly target, quotienting vectorlike pairs only when the physical question allows it. If the preceding healthy Weyl lattice is empty, prove that joint healthy solutions are empty without fabricating a broader search, then classify separately the minimal compensator, signed-kinetic or higher-derivative relaxations and their physical price. Land exact representation tables, Smith/Hilbert-basis or separating-functional certificates, independent verifiers, chirality and conjugation mutations, and a Paper 12 plus public GUT-node claim boundary.
body.current_gate: joint exact Weyl- and gauge-anomaly representation selection within explicit bounded group/weight families
body.forbid: no bounded enumeration called a classification of all gauge theories; no gauge anomaly inferred from dimension alone; no vectorlike cancellation used to erase Weyl coefficients; no negative multiplicity or wrong-sign field called healthy matter; no beta-function sign called ultraviolet completion; no compensator theory called strict pure Weyl; no anomaly solution called a GUT, Standard Model, quantum gravity, particle spectrum, phenomenology or unitarity theorem

or an exact incompatibility theorem within the declared healthy family

body.resource_hint: QUANTUM RESERVE after the matter-content anomaly lattice. Keep the group/rank/weight bounds explicit and exact; use representation theory to prune before any enumeration.
notes: This is an adjacency and universe-building constraint calculation, not a claim that conformal gravity has selected a unified theory.

If ordinary healthy conformal matter cannot cancel the pure-Weyl coefficients, the joint gauge problem may terminate immediately with a composed separating witness; signed extensions remain a distinct theory family.
